description: This file defines a class 'Cheeses' containing a static array of cheese names, along with methods to retrieve all cheese names as a list, or a specified number of randomly selected cheeses. It serves as a dummy data provider for cheese names in an Android app.

classes.name: Cheeses
classes.description: A utility class that supplies a static list of cheese names and methods to access them, including random selection functionality.

methods.name: asList
methods.description: Returns an ArrayList containing all cheese names stored in the static CHEESES array.

methods.name: randomList
methods.description: Returns an ArrayList of a specified number of randomly selected unique cheese names from the CHEESES array.
